items.text: On Codex, open /hooks in a new session after the refresh and trust the plugin's hooks again; changed hook scripts need renewed trust.
Context recording needs a status-line command in your own host settings: setup previews one, or gives a recipe when you already have a status line.
The separate scan-agents, set-mode and setup-instructions skills are gone: use /setup scan, /setup mode and /setup instructions. /setup check lists files that still name them.
On Codex, open /hooks in a new session after the refresh and trust the plugin's hooks again; the session-start hook changed.
The Parallel lines in ## Limits of host.md are no longer read: set the limit again in each repository, then delete those lines by hand and keep the rest of ## Limits.
The away session (/afk) needs its settings recorded first; skip this if you do not use it.
Delegation can record which task levels (1 easy to 5 ultra hard) each helper takes; setup now asks this as part of the assignment matrix.
Move ## Agent roles and ## Agent levels into the assignment matrix: setup runs matrix_setup.py migrate, shows what it drops and asks your consent again.
fnl-ask is now help (on Claude Code type /finolabs-vibecode:help). The old name works only when you type it; instruction files must name help.
The away session can now decide some questions itself: setup asks which kinds of decision stop it, optional non-production targets and a separate excerpt consent.
On Claude Code a new hook holds the question tool during a live away lease; trust the plugin's changed hooks if Claude Code asks.
On Codex, open /hooks in a new session after the refresh and trust the plugin's hooks again; the hook scripts changed.
The verification skill is now called checks, and /verification keeps working as an alias until a later release removes it.
Run /setup add checks to save a check list per repository, with the optional local receipt and pre-push hook.
The same setup step can write, after a previewed yes, a cheaper CI workflow that runs on pull requests and skips document-only changes.
On Codex, open /hooks in a new session after the refresh and trust the plugin's hooks again.
A check list saved with 0.2.4 is no longer read: run /setup add checks again in each repository, then delete the old ## Checks section from host.md by hand.
Parallel limits in host.md are no longer read: set parallel and caps again in each repository before you delete ## Project settings by hand.
Settings in host.md are no longer read: set them again in each repository, then delete ## Project settings and the Ledger project: and Task file: lines by hand.
Labels in host.md are no longer read: set each again inside each repository, then delete the ## Project labels section by hand.
Skills lost the fnl- prefix (fnl-setup is now setup). Old names work only when typed; instruction files must use the new names. /setup check lists each old name with its new one.
/autopilot is now /afk and the ## Autopilot section of host.md is no longer read: run /setup add afk again, then delete the old ## Autopilot section by hand.
session-hygiene is now tidy. The old name works only when typed; instruction files must name tidy. /setup check lists each old name with its new one.
On Codex, open /hooks in a new session after the refresh and trust the plugin's hooks again; the session-start and metrics hooks changed.
After a Claude Code or Codex update, the probes and /setup check say "program changed since setup" and refuse that program until you re-confirm its new path with the quota setup.
Reading the current session's context size on request uses the Claude Code or Codex program confirmed in the quota setup; set that up first.
After a merge, worktree_sweep.py list shows which worktrees are safe to remove, and on Claude Code a hook reminds you after gh pr merge; git's own checks do the removal.
/afk start now prints a goal to type into /goal before you leave, and on Claude Code starts a /loop while work waits on CI, reviews or a delegated run.
The main checkout stays on the default branch: branches are cut in worktrees, and session start says when the main checkout is on another branch.
On Claude Code, type /finolabs-vibecode:help and /finolabs-vibecode:status in full; /help and /status are the host's own commands.
A repository can now set its own away choices: run /setup add afk inside it to set task choice, push, merge, trusted authors and code folders, or keep your user setting.
On Claude Code a hook asks the agent to run tidy at 80% and 90% of the compaction threshold; it needs the window set in compaction setup. FNL_COMPACT_NUDGE=off turns it off.
Compaction setup now warns when a Claude Code setting or environment variable turns auto-compaction off, so the threshold you choose would never fire; it changes nothing.
New shape skill: brainstorming or discussing an idea or design runs an interview through the question tool; the router sends open ideas to it first, and grilling only if you ask for it.
ZCode can be a delegate for code tasks in its edit mode and advice in its plan mode; reviews are not routed to it and the away lease refuses it. /setup scan finds it.
Delegated runs now record when they end; ledger.py stale previews only this repository's records (--all-projects widens it); a review dispatch is accepted on its posted review.
On Claude Code a hook reminds a session, at most every 30 minutes, of its own delegated runs that ended or ran past their budget with no outcome. FNL_DISPATCH_NUDGE=off turns it off.
afk.py check now exits 3 on Tier 3 (0 only on Tier 1), and an away session can run the own-branch flow up to merge and cleanup. Update scripts that relied on exit 0.
Session titles now start with one emoji for the kind of work, from the fixed set in tidy references/titles.md.
Breaking: ## Agent roles is no longer read; without a matrix no review roles are set and the judge is host (no Jev). Setup runs matrix_setup.py migrate and asks consent again.
On Codex, open /hooks in a new session after the refresh and trust the plugin's hooks again; the session-start hook changed.
afk.py check answers exhausted when a lease's runs or runtime are spent (limit is now only the hourly cap) and adds an end line telling the agent to stop its loop once the lease ends.
The setup beginner path asks only the essentials; extras such as the agent scan and companions wait for a later run or /setup add <feature>.
/setup add afk first asks whether the rules are for your account or only this repository, then for a repository asks only the rules you want different.
With Merge allowed, an install read from the main checkout may remove the worktree of a pull request the lease merged; never the main or current checkout, a forced removal or the install's own.
Breaking for away loops: afk limits are now counted per repository, so a lease started before the update reads as invalid; start it again with /afk.
A repository can now set its own afk categories, deploy targets, production deploys and limits; run /setup add afk inside each repository that needs rules different from yours.
Breaking for away flows: the away-decision judge site is gone; afk decisions take an evaluation table (Jev or the small host model) as data, and the ledger logs rung table, not jev.
Under a lease, gh release create must name --repo github.com/OWNER/NAME equal to the verified repository, like a merge.
Under a lease, the author's own family may review only when every other family shows out of quota; merge_check.py --independent --fallback-family checks that and refuses on anything unknown.
An agent line in the assignment matrix may now choose a model per kind of work and level (models rules, with a then fallback when a pool is out of quota); add rules only if you want them.
Under a lease, git switch -c <branch> or git checkout -b <branch> with no start point creates an own work branch when Push and pull requests or Merge is yes; never a default-branch name.
Under a lease, tests run only with a listed test command and a top-level file such as TASKS.md is edited only when listed; run /setup add afk to list them.
/afk start adds a This folder line and afk.py effective a rules field with the rules check applies in that repository; re-running /setup add afk offers your saved values.
Under a lease the advisor runs only on a frontier or strong model listed in delegate references/models.md; a fast-tier or unknown model is denied until the table lists it.
When an update moves a host program, the quota probe and the afk advisor treat that family as unavailable; run /setup add quota to confirm the program again.
Breaking for away flows: git tag, gh release, npm publish and pnpm publish run under a lease only when the exact command is listed; run /setup add afk to list release targets.
Production, release and test command lists and top-level files in ## afk are now every repository's default; a repository's own list replaces it whole. A changed list ends a live lease.
The same-family fallback may merge a change to an enforcer script or instruction file when each review kind has approvals from two different models, each marker naming model=<name>.
On Codex, open /hooks in a new session after the refresh and trust the plugin's hooks again; a UserPromptSubmit hook (the compaction nudge) was added.
On Codex the compaction nudge asks the agent to run tidy at 80% and 90% of model_auto_compact_token_limit, else 90% of the window. FNL_COMPACT_NUDGE=off turns it off.
Under a lease an unknown request of an allowlisted shape goes up the decide ladder and runs once if approved; a merge needs a MERGE OK from merge_check.py --independent within 15 minutes.
An approved check list is now bound to its checkout's full identity; one saved before 0.3.1 still counts until /setup add checks writes it again.
Breaking: ## Agent levels is no longer read; without a matrix no levels are set. Setup runs matrix_setup.py migrate to move them into the matrix and asks consent again.
Breaking: the verification and fnl-verification skill names are removed; type checks instead. Usage metrics recorded under verification count as checks.
The repository moved to github.com/finolabs/vibecode; the plugin keeps its name finolabs-vibecode. Installs of 0.3.0 and earlier stop seeing update notices, so update those once by hand.
Breaking: fnl- skill names are removed (fnl-setup is now setup) and the agents are reviewer, security-reviewer and navigator; use the new names. /setup check lists the old names it finds.
Breaking: afk runs in open mode by default: everything under a lease except credentials, with the default-branch guard on. Add - Mode: strict to ## afk to keep the earlier rules.
Under an open lease merge_check.py --fallback-family accepts same-family reviews with the fallback line and no quota evidence; afk.py rules prints both modes' rules.
/setup add afk can write a local AGENTS.afk.md that overrides instruction-file rules your away rules replace, printed only while a lease is live.
Breaking: the instruction-check consent moved from ## Route judgment to its own ## Instruction check section; until you migrate it reads off and /setup check flags the old section.
Review rework rounds now follow - Rework limit: <2-4> under ## Reviews in host.md (default 2); setup asks it with the review roles.
Claude Code: under a lease a Bash hook judges each command like afk.py check and denies forms it cannot read in full ($VAR, $(...), xargs, find -exec); commit with -F <file>.
Claude Code: a Stop reminder asks for proof when this session committed the head and no passing checks or verify_claim receipt exists for it.
Setup recommends an auto-compact threshold and, on Claude Code, can write it for one repository; there tidy also hands you a ready /compact <focus> command.
Outside a lease you can record a same-family security fallback for when no other family can review; setup asks it with the review roles.
On Codex, open /hooks in a new session after the refresh and trust the plugin's hooks again; the session-start hook changed.
Claude Code: open a coordinator with CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW=<tokens> claude (hooks miss --autocompact); setup can remove per-model values that override your limit.
Claude Code: the compaction reminder follows the session model's own /autocompact value; setup can save a threshold for one model only.
delegate removes finished runs' merged, clean, pushed worktrees in the background; runs started before 0.3.3 stay (worktree_sweep.py list); FNL_WORKTREE_CLEAN=manual or off stops it.
Claude Code: the afk check hook is gone and FNL_AFK_HOOK no longer does anything; under a lease the agent runs afk.py check itself and your host's permissions do the blocking.
Claude Code: under an afk lease, a stop hook sends a turn without an idle or parked record back once, and a permission hook answers prompts from recorded approvals.
Claude Code: afk setup can add native deny rules for the credential floor; /afk start warns while none is set and no approval mode asks.
A repository can let the afk decider merge under any lease, always behind MERGE OK: answer the new merge question in its afk setup.
/setup instructions now flags lines in your instruction files that stop afk or delegate (merge only where you said so, own away rules, machine facts) and proposes fixes.
Routing can stop handing work to one install before its week runs out: record a weekly floor such as claude/work=15 (stop after 85% used).
On Codex, open /hooks in a new session after the refresh and trust the plugin's hooks again; the compaction nudge script changed.
